model.name: Sprint 21 — Contact Identity
model.goal: Make a profile's contact facets - phone, email, address, company - first-class scenario units in the object graph, with phone and email as alternate lookup keys that link a new device to an existing user instead of minting a duplicate. Fix the lobby first-load name, store dropped vCards beside the avatar, and seed Tron's real phone as the first Phone unit on WODA.prod. Phone/Email/Address/Company follow the class-to-method relationship pattern from the profile; Company is shared (dedup by name); Address verification is async against OpenStreetMap.
